page_notes.uniforms: UNIFORMS.BIG (555 banks) and COOPUNIS.BIG (124) are every kit on the disc, and every one of their images is SHPS code 0x0e: a 4x4-block codec at 6 bytes per block whose two 8-bit palette endpoints per block are decoded and whose per-pixel 2-bit selectors are not, after every reading tried left noise inside the blocks. The page lists every kit with its size and palette and draws none; the measurement is in docs/product/EA_SHPS_FORMAT.md section 5. No kit has a PCSX2 replacement name of either kind: a name is derived from decoded pixels and none of these decode, and the three-frame dump that exists confirms none of them either -- both batters in it are wearing kits and not one dumped texture is a decoded code-0x0e image (docs/product/EA_SHPS_FORMAT.md section 5).
page_notes.rosters: The rosters are text: DATABASE.BIG holds 18 RefPack-packed CSV tables (33,808 rows: attrib 2,921 x 46, pitcher 1,430 x 29, roster 2,970 x 10, team 126 x 55 and the batting, pitching, career, organisation and manager tables), and this page edits any cell of any of them, re-packing the table into the slot its entry already owns -- the disc leaves at most three bytes of slack, and the encoder here packs every one of the 18 smaller than EA did, by 10 to 8,687 bytes. The faces are another matter: PORTRAIT.BIG (2,391 banks) and GHEAD.BIG (8,400) are 10,791 images, every one code 0x0e, listed and not drawn. The faces have no PCSX2 replacement name of either kind, for the same reason they are not drawn: none of the 10,791 decodes, and the dump that exists confirms none of them even though a batter introduction card with a portrait on it is one of its three frames.
page_notes.identity: Team names, cities and abbreviations are columns of team.dat and org.dat, edited by the table lane on this page; the menu and in-game strings are the three LOCH files (FEENG.LOC 6,352 strings, IGENG.LOC 1,584, MC_ENG.LOC 41), UTF-16LE, each replaced inside the span it already owns. No rebuilt image has been booted.
page_notes.field_art: FIELDS.BIG (56 banks) and the seven ballpark-builder archives (BPSETUP, BPITEMS, BPUPGRAD, BPTICKET, BPPROMOS, BPVENDOR, BPATTRAC) hold 224 images and every one is code 0x0e, so this page lists them with their sizes and draws none; the reason is the same measurement the uniforms page quotes. None of the 224 has a PCSX2 replacement name of either kind, derived or confirmed, for the same reason none is drawn.
page_notes.stadiums: The 87 /DATA/STADIUM archives hold 25 SHPS banks each, and about 80% of their images are 8-bit and decode: this page exports them and writes an edited PNG back, re-indexed against the image's own palette, inside the bank's slot. The crowd banks (cram.ssh) and the whole of STADIUMS.BIG, the park menu art, are code 0x0e and are listed only. The 31 .ord/.orl objects per park are geometry with no reader here. PCSX2 replacement names: 8,305 of the 12,846 images have a name derived from their own bytes and 816 of those are confirmed against a texture dump -- 59 distinct pictures, most of them one park texture the ballparks share -- so the page says of each texture whether its name was measured or computed.
page_notes.presentation: IGONLY.BIG, COOPOV.BIG and HRSONLY.BIG carry the overlay art and most of it decodes and is editable here; INGAME.BIG's 44 and COOPLAY.BIG's 44 .fel layout scripts are plain text whose grammar is not decoded, so where a value on screen comes from is not established. PCSX2 replacement names: 40 of the 322 images have a derived name and 10 of those are confirmed against a texture dump.
page_notes.menus: The widget banks (FEONLY, SUONLY, SHARED, EASOART, MINIBAT, MINIPIT, MISC, BKGNDS ...), the 396 direct-colour team logos in LOGOS.BIG and the 59 LOADn.BIG loading screens are on this page: 8-bit images export and write back, direct-colour images export only, and every loading screen is code 0x0e and is listed only. The 641 nested .apt dashboard screens in EASOAPT.BIG are counted by the All Textures page and not parsed. PCSX2 replacement names: 317 of the 2,400 images have a derived name and 13 of those are confirmed against a texture dump; the 859 code-0x0e images have neither, because nothing decodes them.
page_notes.crib: The Crib is an ESPN NFL 2K5 feature and not an MVP Baseball concept, so this page stays empty here on purpose; Owner Mode's ballpark builder is art and is filed on the field-art page.
page_notes.audio: Every stream on the disc is listed: the 31 bare SCHl files (six *DAT.BIG beds, 14 .AST crowd and heckle beds, 9 .ASF menu tracks) are EA-XA and play, export and can be replaced inside the bytes they occupy; the 9,123 archived speech entries and the two commentary containers PADAT.BIG and PBPDAT.BIG are MicroTalk and are refused by name, because no decoder for it exists that this project could check against. The two BNKl banks export.
page_notes.gameplay: The boot executable is SLUS_211.35, 8,130,840 bytes, sha256 14db3aa3...753e5c4615, PCSX2 CRC 0544E001, with 44 IRX modules and three RefPack-packed overlays in OVLAY_C.BIG. No patch site on it has been located by this project and no community pnach for this disc is known here, so this page carries no lane rather than a scaffold with nothing on it.
page_notes.playbooks: Baseball has no playbook and the disc confirms it: no play archive and no formation table exist. What this page holds instead is the tuning that decides how the game plays -- PROGRESS.BIG's 8 progression and contract curves, ROOKIE.BIG's 26 draft-class distributions, SCHEDULE.BIG's 9 schedules and the 33 audio event tables -- 76 CSV tables the table lane on this page edits. The 8 PROGRESS tables are stored unpacked with 0 to 3 bytes of slack, so an edit there must keep the table the same length or shorter and is refused by byte count otherwise; the 68 packed tables re-pack with margin. DATAFILE.BIG's 460 one-line hex tables are not CSV and are not edited.
page_notes.saves: An MVP Baseball 2005 memory-card save is not the disc; this studio works off the disc, so nothing here reads or writes a save.
